info.name: CalisHealth - Survey Management API (Content Manager)
info.description:
Kiem thu man Survey management (Content Manager): /api/content/surveys/{surveyCode}/steps.

Chuan bi:
1. Chay backend (Flyway chay V1..V4).
2. Chay server/docs/survey-management/seed_survey_management.sql (sua @cm_email truoc).
3. Import collection nay + environment "CalisHealth - Local"; dien cmEmail / cmPassword (tai khoan Content Manager) va userEmail / userPassword (tai khoan member thuong).

Chay bang Collection Runner TU TREN XUONG. Collection tu don dep (buoc tao ra se bi xoa, thu tu va cau hinh Result duoc tra ve nhu seed) nen chay lai bao nhieu lan cung duoc.

Tai lieu chuc nang: server/docs/survey-management/SURVEY_MANAGEMENT_BE.md

exec: pm.test('it nhat 5 buoc, buoc cuoi la RESULT', () => { pm.expect(j.steps.length).to.be.at.least(5); pm.expect(j.steps[j.steps.length - 1].stepType).to.eql('RESULT'); });
pm.test('counts.all = so buoc; tong 3 tab = all', () => { pm.expect(j.counts.all).to.eql(j.steps.length); pm.expect(j.counts.active + j.counts.draft + j.counts.inactive).to.eql(j.counts.all); });
pm.test('position lien tuc 1..n', () => j.steps.forEach((s, i) => pm.expect(s.position).to.eql(i + 1)));

pm.test('Body information: 4 cau hoi NUMBER + SINGLE_SELECT', () => { pm.expect(body.questionCount).to.eql(4); pm.expect(body.questionTypes).to.have.members(['SINGLE_SELECT', 'NUMBER']); pm.expect(body.updatedAt).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('buoc RESULT khong co cau hoi', () => pm.expect(result.questionCount).to.eql(0));

02. F2 + F5 - Chi tiet va Preview
GET chi tiet buoc Body information

exec: pm.test('co danh sach cau hoi', () => { pm.expect(j.questions.map(q => q.questionCode)).to.include.members(['GENDER', 'AGE', 'HEIGHT', 'WEIGHT']); j.questions.forEach(q => pm.expect(q).to.have.keys('questionCode', 'questionText', 'questionType', 'required', 'sortOrder', 'active', 'conditionalRules')); });
pm.test('buoc QUESTIONS khong co resultConfig', () => pm.expect(j.resultConfig).to.be.null);

item.name: GET preview buoc Goals and motivation (co dieu kien hien thi)

exec: const byCode = c => j.questions.find(q => q.questionCode === c);

pm.test('cung format voi API member (co options)', () => { pm.expect(byCode('GOAL_TYPE').options.map(o => o.optionCode)).to.eql(['HEALTH', 'SKILLS']); pm.expect(byCode('GOAL_TYPE').options[0]).to.have.keys('optionCode', 'label', 'value', 'sortOrder'); });
pm.test('HEALTH_GOAL co dieu kien GOAL_TYPE = HEALTH', () => pm.expect(byCode('HEALTH_GOAL').conditionalRules).to.eql({ operator: 'EQ', questionCode: 'GOAL_TYPE', value: 'HEALTH' }));
pm.test('khong lo id noi bo cua cau hoi', () => j.questions.forEach(q => pm.expect(q).to.not.have.property('id')));

pm.test('"Step 2 of n": danh so tren cac buoc member thay', () => { pm.expect(j.memberStepNumber).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.memberStepCount).to.be.at.least(4); pm.expect(j.visibleToMembers).to.eql(true); });

item.name: GET preview buoc Result

exec: pm.test('khong co cau hoi, co resultConfig', () => { pm.expect(j.questions).to.be.empty; pm.expect(j.resultConfig).to.have.property('planDurationWeeks'); });
pm.test('buoc Result khong danh so Step n of m', () => { pm.expect(j.memberStepNumber).to.be.null; pm.expect(j.memberStepCount).to.be.null; });

exec: pm.test('HEIGHT qua 1 chu so thap phan', () => pm.expect(codeOf('HEIGHT')).to.eql('TOO_MANY_DECIMALS'));
pm.test('GENDER, WEIGHT bat buoc ma chua tra loi', () => { pm.expect(codeOf('GENDER')).to.eql('MISSING_REQUIRED_ANSWER'); pm.expect(codeOf('WEIGHT')).to.eql('MISSING_REQUIRED_ANSWER'); });

pm.test('HEALTH_GOAL hien ra va bat buoc', () => pm.expect(codeOf('HEALTH_GOAL')).to.eql('MISSING_REQUIRED_ANSWER'));

exec: pm.test('cau hoi co du thong tin cho pop-up', () => j.questions.forEach(q => pm.expect(q).to.include.keys('required', 'requiredByDefault', 'unit', 'validationRules', 'active')));

pm.test('khong co cau dang dung o buoc khac (GOAL_TYPE)', () => pm.expect(codes).to.not.include('GOAL_TYPE'));

item.name: PUT Save changes: dao thu tu, tat Required WEIGHT, go GENDER

exec: .map(q => ({ questionCode: q.questionCode, required: q.questionCode === 'WEIGHT' ? false : q.required }));

pm.collectionVariables.set('editBody', JSON.stringify({ revision: Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('bodyRevision')), stepName: o.stepName, description: o.description, status: 'ACTIVE', questions }));
pm.test('thu tu dung nhu da gui', () => pm.expect(active.map(q => q.questionCode)).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('expectedCodes'))));
pm.test('WEIGHT khong con bat buoc', () => pm.expect(active.find(q => q.questionCode === 'WEIGHT').required).to.eql(false));
pm.test('GENDER khong con hien voi member', () => pm.expect(active.map(q => q.questionCode)).to.not.include('GENDER'));
